topic: Other Members of the Solar System
key_concepts: Asteroids are rocky bodies that mostly orbit between Mars and Jupiter.
Comets are frozen balls of dust and ice that orbit the Sun.
Meteoroids are fragments of asteroids or comets.
Asteroids, comets, and meteoroids orbit the Sun.
Meteors appear as streaks of light in the sky.
Meteors are often called shooting stars.
Meteor showers occur when many meteors appear.
A meteor is a streak of light in Earth's atmosphere.
A meteorite is a meteoroid that reaches Earth's surface.
The Kuiper Belt is a region home to dwarf planets.
The Oort Cloud marks the outer edge of the solar system.
Craters are depressions formed on a planet or moon by impacts.
